notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1] Okay Goodie! [/h1]


This patch focuses on completely eliminating the possibility of things falling through the floor as well as preventing players from putting their head through surfaces and potentially [b] spoiling [/b] certain parts of the game for themselves.

As always please feel free to send any bugs, errors, or feedback to: support@ajrpg.com

[u] Hotfix 1.0.2 Patch Notes	[/u]
[list]
    [*]Added re-spawning to all intractable objects
    [*]Added buffer behind walls/floor to prevent seeing through them
    [*]Added pause menu for Return to Main Menu or Quit Application
    [*]Added new logo to main menu
    [*]Fixed double music bug after completing the game
    [*]Various bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: More bug fixes coming your way soon
notes.notes:
Hey all,
As Anderson passes its first weekiversary we've gotten some excellent feedback from the gaming community. Objects still fall through the floor periodically, and there are a few other small things to tidy up. We appreciate your support!

Please feel free to send any bugs, errors, or feedback to: support@ajrpg.com

Thanks!
The AJRPG Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1] Okay Goodie! [/h1]

Here is a small hotfix to address the issue with some items falling through the floor. If an item does fall through it will now respawn at it's last location. There's also a few other fixes. 

Also, those playing using Microsoft Mixed-Reality, we haven't implemented support for this just yet but are working on a patch to include it. Until then you may encounter some game breaking bugs when playing with this mode.

As always please feel free to send any bugs, errors, or feedback to: support@ajrpg.com

[u] Hotfix 1.01 Patch Notes [/u]

[list]
    [*]Raised floor level slightly to account for objects being out of reach
    [*]Added respawning of objects that clip through the floor
    [*]Adjusted locker door opening/closing
[/list]
